statring.label: Stat ring: Ring of Strength <+2> vs Ring of Soulkeeping
statring.explanation: Original: the Ring of Strength <+2> is guessed at 500 (no stat credit), below the Ring of Soulkeeping at 600, so the Borg sells the Ring of Strength. Corrected: 500 + 2 x 200 = 900, so it sells the Ring of Soulkeeping and keeps the Ring of Strength. The game's own values are 1116 (Strength <+2>) and 1050 (Soulkeeping).

inertia.label: Speed penalty: Amulet of Inertia <-2> vs Ring of Soulkeeping
inertia.explanation: Original: the Amulet of Inertia is guessed at its kind cost of 10, below the Ring of Soulkeeping at 600, so the Borg picks it to sell; the shop refuses it ('I do not wish to purchase this item', game value 0) and nothing is sold. Without the floor (earlier fix head 46c6188ec): 10 - 2 x 30000 = -59990. Corrected (floor): 0, so the Borg leaves the amulet out of the sale and sells the Ring of Soulkeeping. The earlier fix head makes the same sale; the floor changes the guess, not this decision.
